name: AECOM (NYSE)
verdict: FLAT — adjudicated 2026-08-22. NAMED KILL: claims-in-contract-assets escalating (+55% in 9mo to $620M) while the charge is marketed as non-recurring (data-class, NOVEL). No price gate — at ~8x ex-charge EV/EBITDA price is not the problem; the premise is.

adjudication.ruling: Red reached REJECT off two findings blue rightly overturned: the 'we are the most bullish analyst' FATAL was a mixed-basis n=3 consensus artifact (range spans BOTH accounting bases; market pays 10.6x the street's own NTM $6.12), and the beta-bleed level-check was inference. What survives audit and kills: disputed claims $400M->$620M in nine months with counter-claim language against a 'one-time' framing; ex-charge margins DOWN 60bp consolidated / 250bp Americas (two sign inversions in the bull brief); JV cash $250.9M -> true net debt ~$1.98B with ~$315M of project burn to come; backlog +13% against street revenue -5.2% = unreconciled conversion problem. FLAT with a dated, decidable re-court.

kills.k: ex-charge margin deterioration (60bp/250bp), brief had sign inverted
